title: NonStationaryBrachistochrone: reproducibility package for controlled-rail brachistochrones in non-stationary spacetimes
description:
Symbolic derivations, numerical verification scripts, figure-generation code, laboratory design studies, and manuscript sources for controlled-rail brachistochrones in non-stationary spacetimes. The repository supports the companion studies of the FLRW and Vaidya sectors and of the conformal Kerr (Thakurta-Kerr) sector.

1.6.1 - two independent cross-audits, and the corrections they produced. Every headline claim of both manuscripts was rebuilt from the printed definitions by two agents working separately, neither using the other's scripts as evidence. The archive now carries both re-derivations.

A false pointwise statement was found and removed. The local classification at the conformal stationary limit asserted that the radial momentum satisfies p_r²(r_e) > 0 in the supercritical case |J| > J_c. It does not: the shape radical carries the explicit factor (r - 2M), so p_r²(r_e) = 0 for every finite J. What separates that case is the sign of the approach, ∂_r S(r_e) = 8M³E²(a² - E²J²), negative above the critical momentum, which makes the neighbourhood inadmissible so that the exterior branch turns at the outer simple root instead. The geometric conclusion - a smooth outer periapsis with exponent two - is unchanged; the pointwise claim was wrong and is corrected in the proposition, the classification table and the response to the referees.

The harmonic-morphism argument is now complete. Non-geodesic fibres alone do not obstruct harmonicity when the dilation is non-constant: the tension field carries a second term, and the two could cancel. Both are computed, and the residual is strictly positive throughout the exterior, so the optical projection is not a harmonic morphism and the obstruction is the same quantity that makes the rail cost something. The coefficients of the optical-curvature expansion are corrected from 24, 48, 8 to 12, 24, 4 - the sign and the threshold at rail energy squared equal to 3/2 are unaffected.

Scope statements replaced overreach. The three-dimensional conjugate-point extension is withdrawn, since the swept-azimuth bound it imported is proved on the proper-time branch while the statements are on the arrival branch, and high-winding classes supply an internal counterexample. The acoustic ergosurface of the analogue platforms is identified with the loss of timelikeness of the selector, not with the energy-dependent freezing condition. The provenance digest now declares its actual scope rather than implying a whole-archive checksum. In the companion paper the open regular set is separated from the compact admissible region, the Minkowski gauge is distinguished from the support function, and the Gronwall estimate is limited to uniqueness and dependence on the initial datum.

Archive. Twenty-one manifest entries, each mapped to one command and one checksum; twenty-three Wolfram Language scripts and three Python scripts under verification, including two new independent re-derivations that rebuild every quantity from the definitions printed in the manuscripts rather than from the scripts they cross-check.
